info.title: Published Establishment API
info.description: Anonymous read-only establishment detail and collection retrieval. Lifecycle: beta. HTTPS origin is environment-specific. The collection supports only an optional status=open or status=closed filter; omission includes both. Detail query-parameter behaviour and numeric throttling limits are not specified. Success responses use application/json; errors use application/problem+json, as stated on each response.

get.description: GET /v1/establishments. Anonymous access. Fixed path is lowercase with no trailing slash. Only status=open or status=closed is supported; omit status to include both Open and Closed records. Values are case-sensitive, are not trimmed and may appear at most once. Empty/repeated/unsupported status values return 400 invalid-status-filter; other query parameter names return 400 unsupported-query-parameter. No request body; a non-empty body returns 400 unexpected-request-body. Unsupported methods return 405 with Allow: GET. Return every matching published establishment in one JSON array without pagination or a wrapper. Use the same full item representation as the detail endpoint for the same published data version; one item per URN, sorted numerically ascending. Omit unpublished records and statuses other than Open and Closed. No matches returns 200 with []. Read one consistent public projection; missing required publication facts in a matching record return 503 publication-incomplete instead of a partial collection. Shared content negotiation, headers and errors apply. Validate filters and resolve publication eligibility before evaluating If-None-Match. Compute the strong ETag over the complete selected array after deterministic UTF-8 serialisation and content coding using the SHA-256/Base64url algorithm of the detail operation. Apply standard weak comparison and wildcard handling. A 304 has no body, Content-Type or Content-Encoding. Last-Modified is not emitted.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: One lowercase value. open selects establishmentStatus.code 1 (Open); closed selects code 2 (Closed). Omit to include both. Empty or repeated values, whitespace and other values return 400 invalid-status-filter. Unknown query parameter names return 400 unsupported-query-parameter.

parameters.name: If-None-Match

200.description: Published Open and Closed establishments selected by the optional status filter. Content-Type: application/json; UTF-8. Return all matches as a JSON array of complete Establishment objects, sorted by URN numerically ascending, with one item per URN. No pagination or wrapper. No matches: 200 with []. This response example illustrates status=open.

get.summary: Get a published establishment by URN
get.description: GET /v1/establishments/{URN}. Fixed path is lowercase with no trailing slash. Validate the matched path URN before lookup. No request body; a non-empty body returns 400 unexpected-request-body. Unsupported methods return 405 with Allow: GET. No authentication. Accept is optional; negotiate application/json using standard media-range and quality-value rules; return 406 if unavailable. Negotiate gzip or identity using Accept-Encoding quality values; return 406 if neither is acceptable. Query-parameter behaviour is not specified. Resolve publication eligibility before evaluating If-None-Match, including weak comparison and wildcard handling. ETags use SHA-256 over exact deterministic representation bytes after UTF-8 JSON serialisation and content coding; encode the 32 digest bytes as unpadded Base64url and enclose in double quotes. Gzip and identity have different tags. Exclude transfer framing. Include all joined public facts; header-only and refresh-only changes do not alter the tag when body bytes are unchanged. A 304 has no body, Content-Type or Content-Encoding. Last-Modified is not emitted.

Establishment.description: One establishment object, returned directly by the detail endpoint or as an item in the collection array. Optional fields are present when applicable, known and published. Omit nulls, empty strings, empty nested objects/arrays and placeholders. The root collection may be empty. Preserve zero, false and meaningful classifications such as None. Clients must tolerate additional properties and future published code values. Select current/historical relationships using explicit state, not the presence of endDate. Missing required publication facts return 503 publication-incomplete. Categories other than those mapped here use the same endpoint and must not return 404 solely because their category is not described here.

EstablishmentCollection.description: All matching published Open and Closed establishments in one consistent public projection. Full item payloads match the detail endpoint. Sort numerically by URN ascending; at most one item per URN. No matches is an empty array. No wrapper or pagination.

x-schema-rules: Optional means present when applicable, known and published; omission reasons are not distinguished in the payload.
Omit nulls, empty strings, empty containers and placeholders. Preserve false, zero and meaningful negative classifications.
Code/name pairs and category assignments must match the published reference mapping; current mappings are not a closed enum.
Statutory low age must not exceed statutory high age.
At most one site has isMainSite true; main site first, other sites ordered by siteId.
Predecessor URL URN must equal the item's urn; links are direct and root-relative.
Select current/historical relationships from explicit state. Relationship periods have inclusive starts and exclusive ends. A future endDate may appear on a current relationship.
Sponsor objects omit academyTrustType. personId is for individuals; companiesHouseNumber is for organisations; do not publish both on one sponsor.
Do not infer sponsor identity from establishment type or operating trust; do not infer foundation-trust support from faith classifications.
A previous LA reference is not proof of a predecessor or a dated maintaining-council relationship.
Published records in other categories use this route; category absence from this contract is not grounds for 404.

An establishment has at most one current sponsor, one current federation membership and one current foundation-trust relationship. Publish sponsor, federation and foundationTrust as conditional objects; omit absent relationships. Historical relationships remain arrays.
GET /v1/establishments accepts only the optional status query parameter: open or closed. Omission includes both Open and Closed published records; other statuses are excluded.
Collection items have the same full Establishment shape as detail responses, one item per URN, sorted by URN numerically ascending. Return all matches in one response; no matches is 200 with [].

Reject empty/repeated/unsupported status values with 400 invalid-status-filter and unsupported collection query parameters with 400 unsupported-query-parameter. Query validation errors use location query.
Do not return partial collections when a selected record lacks required publication facts; return 503 publication-incomplete.
establishmentTypeCategory is a CodedValue with the published EstablishmentTypeGroup code and matching category name. Codes are strings; category UUIDs and lookup IDs are not public codes.
